summary.text: Rat Epidemic is Jiang Bao Ya's enslavement path killer move. Hundreds of thousands of rats self-destruct at once, then yellow poison gas appears.

claims.text: At Meng Qiu, Nu Er Tu’s leopard group fights Jiang Bao Ya’s rat group. Jiang Bao Ya is publicly proclaimed as one of northern plains’ enslavement path masters. Nu Er Tu tells him he has already lost, mocks a scale of six hundred and fifty thousand rats, and says troops are valued for quality not numbers. Jiang Bao Ya answers that he still has a trump card never displayed before and names the killer move Rat Epidemic. Hundreds of thousands of rats self-destruct at the same time. The leopard group takes disastrous casualties in the chain explosion. The ground shakes, turf flips, soil and stones splatter, and yellow poison gas then appears. The surviving leopards become sickly, slow, and weaker in battle. Jiang Bao Ya’s remaining rats move through that gas without being affected.

Nu Er Tu then shouts Leopard Dash. The leopard group’s battle strength surges by over two times and their speed rises by eight times. They charge out of the yellow poison gas, breathe fresh air, and rush forward.

Fang Yuan spends battle merits on dragon horse spirit, three hearts combination soul, other killer moves, and dozens of small strength path inheritances. He also obtains the recorded journal of four enslavement masters. Among the journal’s contents, rat epidemic, thunder explosion, leopard rush, and horse barrage are invaluable.

Fang Yuan names rat epidemic among the killer moves merged into Myriad Self, together with dragon horse spirit, three heads six arms, thunder explosion, leopard rush, horse barrage, three hearts combination soul, beast phantoms, and six arm heavenly zombie king.
